text:
laura: Starting Pyxis Microsystems alpha access thread. Need NDA countersign, bench harness sanity, and a short SI integration checklist before we allocate XM-2 nodes. Who owns each item?
arun: I have the NDA draft (Pyxis_Redwood_Alpha_NDA_2026_draft.pdf) uploaded. Waiting on their GC to sign. Please don't schedule any runs yet.
mina: I'll build the initial bench harness. Plan: perf sweep (seq 512/1024/2048), stability 6h, and quick quant compare (fp16 vs q4_0). Will add --marketplace-tag=pyxis to the harness.
ops-bot: Reminder: hardware access requires countersigned NDA + eng-infra ticket. Use template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue?project=PART and include run_id.
laura: Legal gating is expected. Arun, paste any NDA oddities here so legal can triage.
arun: Pyxis asked for joint use of anonymized graphs and a short 72h review window before publication. No export-control issues but they asked for a non-exclusive usage clause.
sophia: (legal) Recommend amendment: "Redwood and Pyxis may share aggregated, anonymized benchmark metrics for joint marketing after mutual sign-off; raw traces only via time-limited debug token and deleted after 90 days unless otherwise agreed." Also require explicit slide approval step.
mina: Harness prototype (container):
```
./pyxbench --model rwd-7b-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 6 --iters 500 \
  --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood.internal/collect \
  --tags partner:Pyxis,preview:alpha --marketplace-tag pyxis --anon-only
```
mina: Telemetry keys we will emit: ["run_id","model","variant","seq_len","batch_size","tokens_per_sec","p50_ms","p95_ms","p99_ms","vram_pct","gpu_temp_c","partner_project"]. run_id must be a UUID and partner_project=Pyxis-alpha.
laura: Ops: please gate node bookings on NDA attach. We might need 2 x Pyxis-XM2 nodes for a full-day run.
ops-bot: Noted. Action items created: PYXIS-1 (attach countersigned NDA), PYXIS-2 (bench dry-run pending NDA), PYXIS-3 (enforce --anon-only gate).
arun: I'll propose a short amendment to the NDA: aggregated metrics allowed for co-marketing, no raw device logs without express mutual consent.
sophia: That amendment looks fine. Also require an audit trail for any raw trace access and an automatic deletion policy.
mina: Added a flag --debug-token that gates raw trace uploads to a signed URL (valid 7 days). Default is --anon-only. I'll upload a sample aggregated JSON after the dry-run.
laura: Marketing hold: do not announce anything until joint announcement checklist is cleared. I'll own the announcement perf section; Mina please ping @marketing when sample payload is ready.
ops-bot: Lab availability: tentative slot Tue 09:00-13:00 for 2 x XM-2 nodes if NDA attached. Submit run_id and attach NDA to the ticket.
arun: Looping in @sophia and ops in #legal-partnerships and #eng-infra. Countersign expected EOD.
laura: Next sync Thurs 10:00 unless countersign arrives sooner. If countersign misses EOD, shift to Thurs 15:00.
mina: Will post a short results summary here after the dry-run.
sophia: Countersign status: queued; expecting partner exec sign-off within 24h. Will update legal thread.
laura: Thanks everyone.
